amazon: buy a physical product on Amazon: search for an item, work the results list, open and assess a product page (price, rating, variant options, delivery date), add to cart, and check out; complete when the order confirmation or the final checkout review screen with the order total is on screen. Surface pinned: Amazon's own website or app — not a third-party wrapper or assistive shopping app, not a haul/unboxing video, not a deals-roundup or affiliate-listicle without a live purchase session. Variants: returns and refunds (see returns), reordering a past purchase (see reorder), leaving a review (see review), and Amazon Fresh grocery orders (see groceries) do not belong.
banking: carry out an everyday banking task in a bank's own website or app (Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Capital One, a credit union): sign in, then complete one concrete arc — transfer money between accounts, deposit a check with the camera, or find and download/read a statement — through the bank's review-and-confirm step; complete when the bank's confirmation of the transfer or deposit (or the opened statement) is on screen. Surface pinned: the bank's own app or site — not p2p apps (Venmo/Cash App belong to the p2p domain), not budgeting apps, not crypto exchanges.
dmv: renew a driver's license or vehicle registration on a state DMV portal: verify identity and eligibility, work through the renewal form, pay the fee; complete when the renewal-submitted confirmation — receipt or temporary document — is on screen. Surface pinned: a state DMV web portal, not an in-office visit vlog. Variants: address change (seeded variant), first-time license applications, REAL ID upgrades, and driving-test booking do not belong.
doctor: book a doctor appointment online (Zocdoc, MyChart and other patient portals, clinic sites): search or pick a provider, filter by insurance and visit reason, pick an open slot, identify as the patient, confirm; complete when the appointment confirmation with provider, date, and time is on screen. Surface pinned: a medical booking site or patient portal on web or app. Variants: prescription refills (seeded variant), attending the telehealth visit itself, and researching providers without booking do not belong.
flights: book a flight online (Google Flights, airline websites and apps, Expedia, Kayak): search a route and dates, compare fares and times, pick an outbound and return, enter passenger details, and reach the payment or confirmation step; complete when a booking confirmation or itinerary summary with the fare total is on screen. Surface pinned: a flight-booking site or airline app — not an airport kiosk, not a travel vlog, not a points/miles explainer without a live booking session. Variants: checking in for a flight (see checkin), researching and comparing without booking (see itinerary), and hotel or car add-ons after the flight is booked do not belong.
hotel: book a hotel room online (Booking.com, Expedia, hotel brand sites): search destination and dates, compare properties and rates, pick a room and rate plan, enter guest and payment details, book; complete when the reservation confirmation with dates and a confirmation number is on screen. Surface pinned: a hotel-booking website or app. Variants: Airbnb-style stays that require host approval, booking flights, and cancelling an existing reservation do not belong.
mapnav: get directions to a specific place with an online map (Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze): search the destination, pick a travel mode, review the route options (time, tolls, transit lines), and start navigation or read off the chosen route; complete when the chosen route with its ETA is on screen or turn-by-turn navigation has begun. Surface pinned: the map product itself — not dashcam or driving footage, not travel vlogs that happen to show a map.
patientportal: use a patient portal (MyChart, FollowMyHealth, LabCorp or Quest portals, a health system's own portal): sign in and complete one concrete arc — view test results, read or send a message to the care team, view or download a visit summary or medical record, or check in for an upcoming visit; complete when the result, message, or record is on screen. Surface pinned: the portal itself — not symptom research (healthinfo), not appointment booking (doctor), not pharmacy refills (refill).
privacy: change privacy or account settings and verify they took effect (Google privacy checkup / activity controls, Facebook or Instagram privacy settings, TikTok privacy, iPhone app permissions): open the settings, find the specific control (ad personalization, private/public account, location access, activity history), change it, and confirm the new state is shown; complete when the changed setting visibly shows its new state on screen. Surface pinned: the settings pages of a major account or device. Variants: VPN marketing, general privacy-advice talking heads, jailbreak/bypass content, and enterprise admin-console content do not belong.
recipe: find a recipe that matches specific constraints and save it (Allrecipes, Cookpad, Food Network Kitchen, Paprika, Pinterest recipes, NYT Cooking): search for a dish, apply the constraints that matter (dietary restriction like gluten-free/vegan, excluded ingredient, time limit, rating), open a matching recipe, check its ingredient list against the constraints, and save/bookmark it to a collection; complete when the saved state (recipe in favorites/collection) is on screen. Surface pinned: a recipe site or cooking app's search and save flow. Variants: actual cooking footage (kitchen videos) as the main subject, recipe-development/food-blogging business content, meal-kit unboxings, and "what I eat in a day" content do not belong.
ride: get a ride with a rideshare app (Uber, Lyft; paratransit and access services count as sites): set pickup and destination, compare ride options and price, request, get matched with a driver, track the approach on the map, and verify the car and driver at pickup; complete when the ride is in progress or finished with the fare screen — at minimum, the matched-driver tracking screen after the request commits. Surface pinned: a rideshare app. Variants: driving for the platform (driver side), food delivery, and renting a car do not belong.
taxes: file a personal tax return online (TurboTax, FreeTaxUSA, H&R Block): enter or import income documents (W-2, 1099), work through the interview screens, review the refund-or-owed summary, e-file; complete when the return-submitted / e-file confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: the web interface of a tax-filing service. Variants: checking refund status afterwards, filing through a human accountant, and standalone refund-estimator calculators do not belong.
